text:
Aria: Customer INC-6882 reports 400 on /v1/invoke, says it worked yesterday. Payload attached, error message: "schema validation failed" with issues for 'session' and 'debugMode'.
Devon: can you paste the raw payload and the exact API response body?
Aria: sure — response: `400` and body: `{
  "error": "schema validation failed",
  "details": ["session: expected object, got null", "additionalProperties: debugMode not allowed"]
}`
Devon: ugh additionalProperties=false on the tool schema then. customer payload?
Aria: payload they sent: ```json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-v1",
  "input": "Summarize...",
  "session": null,
  "debugMode": true
}```
Samira: repro steps from my side: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoke 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  --data-binary @payload.json  (payload.json is exactly what Aria pasted)
SupportBot: New ticket created: INC-6882 (auto)
Devon: same validation error locally. Schema for the tool's `invoke` path defines `session` as required object and `additionalProperties: false` on the root. If client sends `null` for session it triggers type mismatch; and any extra key like debugMode gets rejected.
Aria: customer says their SDK used to send null for session — older server tolerated it. Breaking change after a schema tighten last deploy?
Liam: tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for triage. cc @eng-runtime. What changed in last deploy?
Devon: quick check of release notes — rollout 2026-03-15 included stricter JSON schema enforcement for tool invokes (PR #1129). That likely flipped additionalProperties enforcement.
Samira: logs show: `validation_error: additionalProperties = [debugMode], path=/, validator=additionalProperties` and `type_error: expected object but got null, path=/session` in the validation library output.
Devon: mitigation options: 1) server-side shim to coerce null -> {} and drop unknown keys for a short window, 2) update tool schema to allow additionalProperties (more permissive), 3) ask customer to patch SDK to omit session when null and remove debugMode.
Aria: customer is enterprise and on Dedicated; they need quick fix, they can't patch right now. Prefer server-side hotfix.
Liam: agree, escalate for hotfix. I'll open an urgent PR to relax additionalProperties for invoke root and accept null for session (coerce).
Devon: to be safe, implement a fatal-metric and fallback log so we can roll back if regressions. Also add a one-off migration to transform incoming null session to {} in the pre-validate hook.
Samira: repro verified that changing the pre-validate shim makes the payload accepted and the tool executes as expected. Output looks correct.
Aria: told customer workaround: we will deploy a short-lived shim in ~30m and notify. They confirmed accept.
Liam: creating incident channel and assigning owner. IncidentPR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-1187 (hotfix: pre-validate null->object, allow additionalProperties for 48h).
Devon: after hotfix deploy, follow up with a proper schema-lockdown plan: update SDKs and changelog, add a compatibility test to our CI that sends null session + extra keys.
Aria: thanks team. I'll update the support ticket and send the customer the ETA.
SupportBot: INC-6882 updated: hotfix deployed to canary.
Liam: moving to eng-runtime for postmortem + next steps.
